intent: Aionis Continuation Runtime V1 complexity budget V2. File counts plus nonproduction, test, gate, tool, and resource line counts are authenticated observations. Hard thresholds retain downward line ratchets across every production entry and union, the 1200-line source-file boundary, zero runtime cycles and full type-dependency SCCs, exact route/environment/schema/resource inventories, and the collector-enforced daemon capability boundary.
ratchet_policy: Hard line ceilings may only decrease. Observations may change and do not fail the gate. Any threshold increase or reset requires explicit architecture review, a new stable inventory, and a reviewed baseline digest; runtime-cycle and full-type-SCC zero invariants are non-resettable.
strict_activation: The clean-break deletion is complete. --strict-no-legacy is mandatory and fails closed on every legacy source, script, tool, or resource artifact.
